subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should OpenClaw expose `captionedFinalText` as the public channel TTS capability for captioned final-mode voice replies before merging this PR?
rationale: The implementation is plausible, but the new plugin SDK capability becomes an external channel contract and changes visible Telegram message-delivery timing.

options.title: Accept Capability After Proof
options.body: Keep `captionedFinalText` as the generic channel contract and require current-head Telegram proof for always, tagged, media, and fallback behavior before merge.

options.title: Keep It Telegram-Local
options.body: Ask for a narrower Telegram-owned implementation that avoids a public SDK capability until another channel needs the seam.

options.title: Defer To Delivery Policy
options.body: Pause this branch in favor of a broader TTS delivery-mode design that also covers separate text-plus-voice preferences.

recommendation.title: Accept Capability After Proof
recommendation.body: Keep `captionedFinalText` as the generic channel contract and require current-head Telegram proof for always, tagged, media, and fallback behavior before merge.
